note: Every question the seller asks in the twelve scripts, labeled by hand before the heuristic was scored. Open means the question asks the buyer to explain in their own words. Closed means it can be answered with yes, no, a name, a number or another single fact, which includes proposals phrased as questions. evals/questions.py scores engine/coaching.py's open-question rule against these.
